examples.text_en: He had become estranged from his own family.
examples.text_zh: 他已经和自己的家人疏远了。

examples.text_en: The estranged friends had not met for years.
examples.text_zh: 这对疏远的朋友已经好几年没见过面。

examples.text_en: The river meets the sea at a wide estuary.
examples.text_zh: 河水在宽阔的河口处汇入大海。

examples.text_en: They walked along the estuary in the morning.
examples.text_zh: 他们早晨沿着河口散步。

examples.text_en: The old etching hung on the wall for years.
examples.text_zh: 那幅旧蚀刻版画在墙上挂了好多年。

examples.text_en: He made a fine etching of the old house.
examples.text_zh: 他为那座老房子做了一幅精美的蚀刻版画。

examples.text_en: Her voice had an ethereal and gentle quality.
examples.text_zh: 她的嗓音有一种轻柔飘渺的质感。

examples.text_en: An ethereal light filled the whole quiet room.
examples.text_zh: 一种飘渺的光充满了整个安静的房间。

examples.text_en: A strong work ethic helped him in his career.
examples.text_zh: 强烈的职业道德在他的事业上帮了大忙。

examples.text_en: The old ethic of the group was hard work.
examples.text_zh: 这个团体旧的伦理就是勤奋工作。

examples.text_en: They tried to act ethically in every case.
examples.text_zh: 他们力求在每件事上都合乎伦理。

examples.text_en: The question was ethically hard for the team.
examples.text_zh: 这个问题在伦理上让团队很为难。

examples.text_en: He studied ethnology at the old university.
examples.text_zh: 他在那所老大学里研究人种学。

examples.text_en: Her work on ethnology took many long years.
examples.text_zh: 她的人种学研究花了许多年。

examples.text_en: The whole school had a warm and open ethos.
examples.text_zh: 整所学校有一种温暖开放的精神气质。

examples.text_en: Their ethos of hard work was known to all.
examples.text_zh: 他们勤奋的精神人人皆知。

examples.text_en: The teacher talked about the etymology of words.
examples.text_zh: 老师讲了词语的语源。

examples.text_en: He studies etymology at the new university.
examples.text_zh: 他在那所新大学里研究语源学。

examples.text_en: A tall eucalyptus stood near the old road.
examples.text_zh: 一棵高大的桉树立在老路旁。

examples.text_en: They found eucalyptus trees along the water.
examples.text_zh: 他们沿着水边发现了桉树。

examples.text_en: They talked about eugenic ideas in the old book.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈到那本旧书里的优生学观点。

examples.text_en: The eugenic study was not based on good facts.
examples.text_zh: 那项优生学研究并没有可靠的事实依据。

examples.text_en: He wrote a eulogistic note about the old king.
examples.text_zh: 他写了一篇颂扬老王的话。

examples.text_en: The eulogistic words made everyone feel good.
examples.text_zh: 那些颂扬的话让每个人都感觉很好。

examples.text_en: They will eulogize the old teacher at school.
examples.text_zh: 他们将在学校颂扬这位老教师。

examples.text_en: He tried to eulogize his friend in a few words.
examples.text_zh: 他设法用几句话称赞自己的朋友。

examples.text_en: She gave a fine eulogy for the old man.
examples.text_zh: 她为这位老人献上了一篇优美的赞词。

examples.text_en: His eulogy of the book was long and warm.
examples.text_zh: 他对这本书的称颂又长又热情。

examples.text_en: The words were a euphemism for a hard truth.
examples.text_zh: 这些话是对一个严酷事实的委婉说法。

examples.text_en: He used a euphemism to soften the bad news.
examples.text_zh: 他用了一个委婉的说法来缓和这个坏消息。

examples.text_en: The euphony of her song filled the old room.
examples.text_zh: 她歌声的悦耳之音充满了那间老屋。

examples.text_en: They loved the euphony of the old song.
examples.text_zh: 他们喜爱这首老歌悦耳的调子。

examples.text_en: The whole team felt a deep euphoria after the win.
examples.text_zh: 获胜后整个团队都沉浸在深深的兴奋之中。

examples.text_en: His euphoria did not last more than a day.
examples.text_zh: 他的兴奋没有持续超过一天。

examples.text_en: The man tried to evade the police again.
examples.text_zh: 那人又想避开警察。

examples.text_en: She would evade every hard question about the plan.
examples.text_zh: 她会回避每一个关于这个计划的难题。

examples.text_en: We must evaluate the plan before the meeting.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须在会前评估这个方案。

examples.text_en: The teacher will evaluate the work of each student.
examples.text_zh: 老师将评价每个学生的作业。

examples.text_en: The evaluation of the plan took a whole week.
examples.text_zh: 对这个方案的评估花了整整一周。

examples.text_en: They asked for a fair evaluation of their work.
examples.text_zh: 他们要求对自己的工作作出公正的评价。

examples.text_en: The beauty of the day was evanescent and brief.
examples.text_zh: 这一天的美好短暂易逝。

examples.text_en: Fame is often evanescent in the world of art.
examples.text_zh: 在艺术界，名声往往转瞬即逝。

examples.text_en: The evaporation of the water took a few days.
examples.text_zh: 水的蒸发用了几天时间。

examples.text_en: High heat can cause the evaporation of the lake.
examples.text_zh: 高温会使湖水蒸发。

examples.text_en: He is a calm and even-tempered old man.
examples.text_zh: 他是个性情平和的老人。

examples.text_en: She stayed even-tempered through the whole long day.
examples.text_zh: 她整天都保持着平和的心情。

examples.text_en: The teacher was evenhanded with every student.
examples.text_zh: 老师对每个学生都一视同仁。

examples.text_en: They asked for an evenhanded and fair decision.
examples.text_zh: 他们要求一个公平公正的决定。

examples.text_en: It was an eventful year for the whole family.
examples.text_zh: 对全家人来说，这是多事的一年。

examples.text_en: The eventful day began with a piece of news.
examples.text_zh: 这个多事的一天从一条消息开始。

examples.text_en: Their eventual win made the whole town happy.
examples.text_zh: 他们最终的胜利让全镇人都高兴。

examples.text_en: He knew the eventual answer would be yes.
examples.text_zh: 他知道最终的答案会是同意。

examples.text_en: They hoped for everlasting peace in the world.
examples.text_zh: 他们盼望世界上有永恒的和平。

examples.text_en: Her everlasting love was a gift to her children.
examples.text_zh: 她那永恒的爱是给孩子们的礼物。

examples.text_en: They had to evict the man from the house.
examples.text_zh: 他们不得不把这个人从房子里赶出去。

examples.text_en: The owner will evict them before the next month.
examples.text_zh: 房主会在下个月前把他们赶出去。

examples.text_en: The eviction of the family caused a lot of pain.
examples.text_zh: 这家人的被逐出带来了很大的痛苦。

examples.text_en: They talked about the eviction for many hours.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈论这件事谈了好几个小时。

examples.text_en: His face would evince a deep and quiet joy.
examples.text_zh: 他的脸上会流露出深沉而安静的喜悦。

examples.text_en: The report will evince the true state of things.
examples.text_zh: 这份报告会表明事情的真正状况。

examples.text_en: They will eviscerate the fish before cooking.
examples.text_zh: 他们会在做鱼之前取出内脏。

examples.text_en: The new rules would eviscerate the whole plan.
examples.text_zh: 新规则会把整个计划掏空。

examples.text_en: The old song was evocative of my early days.
examples.text_zh: 这首老歌让我想起早年的日子。

examples.text_en: Her words were evocative and full of feeling.
examples.text_zh: 她的话能唤起情感，充满意味。

examples.text_en: The picture can evoke a strong feeling of home.
examples.text_zh: 这幅画能唤起强烈的思乡之情。

examples.text_en: Her story would evoke a smile from everyone.
examples.text_zh: 她的故事让每个人都露出了微笑。

examples.text_en: They studied the evolutionary change over many years.
examples.text_zh: 他们研究了许多年间的进化变化。

examples.text_en: The evolutionary path of the group was very long.
examples.text_zh: 这个群体的进化历程非常漫长。

examples.text_en: The ewe led her young one to the water.
examples.text_zh: 母羊带着小羊去水边。

examples.text_en: A white ewe stood on the green hill.
examples.text_zh: 一只白色的母羊站在绿色的山坡上。

examples.text_en: She put the old ewer on the table.
examples.text_zh: 她把那个旧水壶放在桌上。

examples.text_en: A fine ewer held water for the whole family.
examples.text_zh: 一只漂亮的水壶盛着全家用的水。

examples.text_en: The long wait would exacerbate his bad feeling.
examples.text_zh: 漫长的等待会加剧他的不快。

examples.text_en: Hard words can exacerbate the whole situation.
examples.text_zh: 刻薄的话会让整个局面更加恶化。

examples.text_en: The work was exacting and took all my power.
examples.text_zh: 这项工作要求严苛，耗尽了我全部的力气。

examples.text_en: Her exacting teacher asked for perfect work.
examples.text_zh: 她那位严苛的老师要求完美。

examples.text_en: He did the work with great exactitude and care.
examples.text_zh: 他极为精确而仔细地做这项工作。

examples.text_en: The exactitude of her answer surprised the group.
examples.text_zh: 她回答的精确让在场的人都吃惊。

examples.text_en: That was a clear exaggeration of the true facts.
examples.text_zh: 那显然是对事实的夸大。

examples.text_en: His story was full of exaggeration and big words.
examples.text_zh: 他的故事里满是夸张和空话。

examples.text_en: The king will exalt him for his long service.
examples.text_zh: 国王将因他的长期效劳而提升他。

examples.text_en: They exalt the old song as a work of art.
examples.text_zh: 他们把这首老歌赞为艺术之作。

examples.text_en: His exaltation at the news was clear to all.
examples.text_zh: 他听到消息时的得意大家都看得出来。

examples.text_en: The exaltation of the young man came too soon.
examples.text_zh: 这个年轻人升得太快了。

examples.text_en: He held an exalted place in the old court.
examples.text_zh: 他在老王宫里身居高位。

examples.text_en: She had an exalted idea of her own work.
examples.text_zh: 她对自己的工作评价过高。

examples.text_en: The long delay would exasperate the whole group.
examples.text_zh: 长时间的拖延会让整个群体恼怒。

examples.text_en: His bad habits exasperate his old mother.
examples.text_zh: 他的坏习惯让老母亲很生气。

examples.text_en: They plan to excavate the old hill for stone.
examples.text_zh: 他们打算挖开那座老山采石。

examples.text_en: Workers will excavate the ground near the house.
examples.text_zh: 工人们将挖掘房子附近的地面。

examples.text_en: The old book was exceedingly hard to find.
examples.text_zh: 这本旧书非常难找。

examples.text_en: She was exceedingly kind to the young children.
examples.text_zh: 她对幼小的孩子们非常和善。

examples.text_en: His words were exceptionable and made us angry.
examples.text_zh: 他的话令人反感，让我们很生气。

examples.text_en: There was nothing exceptionable in her fine work.
examples.text_zh: 她出色的工作无可指摘。

examples.text_en: Her work was exceptional and won the big prize.
examples.text_zh: 她的工作非常出色，赢得大奖。

examples.text_en: The team showed exceptional power in the final game.
examples.text_zh: 这支队伍在决赛中表现出非凡的实力。

examples.text_zh: 他朗读了那本旧书的一段摘录。

examples.text_en: The excerpt was short but full of meaning.
examples.text_zh: 这段摘录虽短，却意味深长。

examples.text_en: The exchequer had little money left that year.
examples.text_zh: 那一年国库里剩下的钱很少。

examples.text_en: They asked the exchequer for help with the road.
examples.text_zh: 他们请财政部拨款修路。

examples.text_en: The government put an excise on the new drink.
examples.text_zh: 政府对这种新饮料征收消费税。

examples.text_en: They paid a high excise on the good wine.
examples.text_zh: 他们为这些好酒缴了很高的消费税。

examples.text_zh: 他容易激动，很难相处。

examples.text_en: The excitability of the child worried his mother.
examples.text_zh: 孩子容易兴奋，让母亲有点担心。

examples.text_en: The excitable dog wanted to run all day.
examples.text_zh: 这只容易兴奋的狗整天都想跑。

examples.text_en: She was excitable and loved every new thing.
examples.text_zh: 她容易兴奋，喜欢每一件新鲜事。

examples.text_en: The exclusion of the poor was a real problem.
examples.text_zh: 把穷人排除在外是个很严重的问题。

examples.text_en: They talked about the exclusion of young people.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈到了把年轻人排除在外的问题。

examples.text_en: The club was exclusive and did not want us.
examples.text_zh: 这家俱乐部很排外，不想接纳我们。

examples.text_en: They gave her exclusive rights to the old song.
examples.text_zh: 他们把这首老歌的专有权给了她。

examples.text_en: They use the room exclusively for small meetings.
examples.text_zh: 这个房间只用于小型会议。

examples.text_en: She works exclusively with young children.
examples.text_zh: 她只和幼小的孩子打交道。

examples.text_en: He tried to excogitate a new way to work.
examples.text_zh: 他设法想出一种新的工作方法。

examples.text_en: They will excogitate a plan for the whole team.
examples.text_zh: 他们将为整个团队设计一个方案。

examples.text_en: The writer would excoriate the bad plan in public.
examples.text_zh: 这位作者会公开斥责这个糟糕的计划。

examples.text_en: They excoriate him for the great loss of money.
examples.text_zh: 他们因这笔巨大损失而严厉责备他。

examples.text_en: The excrement of the dog was on the road.
examples.text_zh: 狗的粪便落在路上。

examples.text_en: They found excrement near the old water.
examples.text_zh: 他们在旧水边发现了粪便。

examples.text_en: The body will excrete what it does not need.
examples.text_zh: 身体会排出它不需要的东西。

examples.text_en: Some animals excrete a strong and bad smell.
examples.text_zh: 有些动物会排出强烈的臭味。

examples.text_en: The bad news would excruciate the poor mother.
examples.text_zh: 这个坏消息会让可怜的母亲痛苦不堪。

examples.text_en: They would excruciate him with hard questions.
examples.text_zh: 他们会用刁钻的问题折磨他。

examples.text_en: The new facts will exculpate the young man.
examples.text_zh: 新的证据将证明这个年轻人无罪。

examples.text_en: He tried to exculpate himself from the whole thing.
examples.text_zh: 他设法为自己开脱整件事的责任。

examples.text_en: His excursive talk went from one thing to another.
examples.text_zh: 他散漫的谈话从一件事跳到另一件事。

examples.text_en: The excursive book tells of many far places.
examples.text_zh: 这本游记讲述了远方许多地方的见闻。

examples.text_en: The food was execrable and we left at once.
examples.text_zh: 食物糟透了，我们立刻就离开了。

examples.text_en: He had an execrable way of talking to people.
examples.text_zh: 他跟人说话的方式很令人讨厌。

examples.text_en: They would execrate the man who caused the loss.
examples.text_zh: 他们会诅咒那个造成损失的人。

examples.text_en: He began to execrate his own bad luck.
examples.text_zh: 他开始诅咒自己的坏运气。

examples.text_en: His words of execration were heard by all.
examples.text_zh: 他诅咒的话被所有人都听到了。

examples.text_en: They spoke of him with execration and fear.
examples.text_zh: 他们提起他时满是憎恶和恐惧。

examples.text_en: This small case can exemplify the whole problem.
examples.text_zh: 这个小案例可以说明整个问题。

examples.text_en: She tried to exemplify the rule with a story.
examples.text_zh: 她试着用一个故事来举例说明这条规则。

examples.text_en: The group will exert its power in the next game.
examples.text_zh: 这个团体将在下一场比赛中施展实力。

examples.text_en: He had to exert all his strength to win.
examples.text_zh: 他不得不使出全部力气才赢。

examples.text_zh: 这段长路对他来说是很大的体力消耗。

examples.text_en: He won the prize by his own hard exertion.
examples.text_zh: 他靠自己的艰苦努力赢得了奖项。

examples.text_en: The long trip was exhausting for the whole family.
examples.text_zh: 这趟长途旅行让全家人都筋疲力尽。

examples.text_en: Her work is exhausting but she loves it.
examples.text_zh: 她的工作很累人，但她很喜欢。

examples.text_zh: 跑完长跑后，他累得瘫倒。

examples.text_en: The exhaustion of the team was clear to all.
examples.text_zh: 这支队伍的疲惫大家都看得出来。

examples.text_en: The report was exhaustive and took many months.
examples.text_zh: 这份报告十分详尽，花了好几个月。

examples.text_en: They made an exhaustive study of the old law.
examples.text_zh: 他们对这部旧法律作了详尽的研究。

examples.text_en: The fresh air would exhilarate the whole group.
examples.text_zh: 清新的空气会让整个队伍精神振奋。

examples.text_en: Good news can exhilarate a tired young man.
examples.text_zh: 好消息能让疲惫的年轻人振作起来。

examples.text_en: The long walk was exhilarating and full of light.
examples.text_zh: 这次长途步行令人愉快，一路有阳光相伴。

examples.text_en: It was an exhilarating day for the young team.
examples.text_zh: 对这支年轻队伍来说，这是令人兴奋的一天。

examples.text_en: A deep exhilaration filled the whole team.
examples.text_zh: 整个队伍都充满了深深的喜悦。

examples.text_en: He felt a great exhilaration after the hard work.
examples.text_zh: 辛苦工作之后，他感到非常畅快。

examples.text_zh: 老师会劝勉学生用功读书。

examples.text_zh: 他们劝诫我们要保持以往的好习惯。

examples.text_zh: 为了做新的检验，他们不得不掘出遗体。

examples.text_zh: 工人们将挖出那个古老的石箱。

examples.text_zh: 对水的迫切需求大家都看得很清楚。

examples.text_zh: 他在办公室遇到了一个紧急的问题。

examples.text_en: Their exiguous food had to last many days.
examples.text_zh: 他们那点少得可怜的食物得撑好些天。

examples.text_zh: 他剩下的钱少得可怜。

examples.text_zh: 他在流放中度过了许多漫长的岁月。

examples.text_zh: 这部电影有很深的关于存在的意味。

examples.text_zh: 他提出了一个关于我们生命存在的根本问题。

examples.text_zh: 身体的外分泌部分负责这项工作。

examples.text_zh: 他们在课上研究了外分泌系统。

examples.text_zh: 新的事实终将证明他无罪。

examples.text_zh: 他们设法为这个人开脱所有的责任。

examples.text_zh: 他们为那座老房子要价过高。

examples.text_zh: 这趟旅行的花费对我们来说高得离谱。

examples.text_zh: 他们试图为他驱除身上的邪灵。

examples.text_en: The old man would exorcise the empty house.
examples.text_zh: 这位老人会为那座空房子驱邪。

examples.text_en: She loved the exotic food of that far land.
examples.text_zh: 她喜欢那个遥远国度的异国食物。

examples.text_en: They brought exotic plants to the old garden.
examples.text_zh: 他们把外来的植物带到了老花园里。

examples.text_en: A great expanse of water lay before us.
examples.text_zh: 我们面前是一大片宽阔的水域。

examples.text_en: The expanse of the field was full of green.
examples.text_zh: 这片田野辽阔，满眼绿色。

examples.text_en: The house had an expansive view of the sea.
examples.text_zh: 这所房子能看到广阔的海景。

examples.text_en: He has an expansive way of talking about his plans.
examples.text_zh: 他谈起自己的计划时总是滔滔不绝。

examples.text_en: He began to expatiate on the old story.
examples.text_zh: 他开始详细讲述那个古老的故事。

examples.text_en: She would expatiate about her work for hours.
examples.text_zh: 她会一连几个小时细说自己的工作。

examples.text_en: The expatriate missed his home in the north.
examples.text_zh: 这位侨居者想念北方的家乡。

examples.text_en: A group of expatriate friends met every week.
examples.text_zh: 一群侨居的朋友每周都聚会。

examples.text_en: There was a great expectancy before the game.
examples.text_zh: 比赛前人们怀着很大的期待。

examples.text_en: Her expectancy showed in her bright eyes.
examples.text_zh: 她的期待写在明亮的眼睛里。

examples.text_en: They chose the plan for its expediency.
examples.text_zh: 他们出于权宜之计选择了这个方案。

examples.text_en: The expediency of the answer was clear to us.
examples.text_zh: 这个办法的权宜性我们看得很清楚。

examples.text_en: The new rule was only a short expedient.
examples.text_zh: 这条新规定只是个短期的权宜之计。

examples.text_en: They looked for an expedient to save the plan.
examples.text_zh: 他们寻找一个权宜之计来挽救这个计划。

examples.text_en: The new road will expedite work on the house.
examples.text_zh: 新路会加快房子的施工进度。

examples.text_en: They asked for more help to expedite the process.
examples.text_zh: 他们请求更多帮手来加快进程。

examples.text_en: They made an expeditious end to the whole thing.
examples.text_zh: 他们很快把这件事了结了。

examples.text_en: Her work was expeditious and free of errors.
examples.text_zh: 她的工作迅速而没有差错。

examples.text_en: They will expend a lot of money on the road.
examples.text_zh: 他们会在这条路上花很多钱。

examples.text_en: He did not want to expend all his energy.
examples.text_zh: 他不想耗尽自己所有的精力。

examples.text_en: The experimental work took the whole long year.
examples.text_zh: 这项实验工作花了整整一年。

examples.text_en: They used an experimental way to grow the food.
examples.text_zh: 他们用一种实验性的方法种植食物。

examples.text_en: They tested the new drug experimentally last year.
examples.text_zh: 他们去年对那种新药做了实验测试。

examples.text_en: The idea was tested experimentally before we used it.
examples.text_zh: 这个想法在我们采用之前经过了实验检验。

examples.text_en: Long experimentation led to a fine new way.
examples.text_zh: 长期的实验带来了一个新好方法。

examples.text_en: They spent years of experimentation on the plan.
examples.text_zh: 他们为这个方案花了多年时间做实验。
